raw_segments.text: Mr. Trab then bent over number four, and in a sort of deferential confidence, recommended
it to me as a light article for summer wear, an article much in vogue among the nobility
and gentry, an article that it would ever be an honor to him to reflect upon a distinguished
fellow townsman's, if he might claim me for a fellow townsman, having worn.
Are you bringing numbers five and eight, you vagabond? said Mr. Trab to the boy after that.
Or shall I kick you out of the shop and bring them myself?
